-- The client says: Fired when the state of an addon restriction type is changing. This event is sequenced such that it will always be fired before a restriction becomes active, or after it is deactivated.
local frame = CreateFrame("Frame")
frame:RegisterEvent("ADDON_RESTRICTION_STATE_CHANGED")
frame:SetScript("OnEvent", function(self, event, type, state)
end)
